dedupe_resolutions.notes: LEG-004093 records EPA's July 2025 announcement that it would pursue repeal of the endangerment finding. NAT-2026-08-27-014 records a later peer-reviewed quantitative effectiveness and cost analysis of the implemented 2026 vehicle-policy rollback, with a different date, evidence question, and outcome measure. The records are related stages, not duplicate counts of one action.

rejected_candidates.title: No new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: The validated source remained at 35,870 posts. The newest post remained August 27 at 10:17:04 PM EDT, so no post-boundary Truth Social lead existed to evaluate as an additional federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: Interagency Autism Coordinating Committee strategic-plan vote
rejected_candidates.reason: Independent reporting described adoption of a nonbinding plan recommending roughly doubled annual autism spending, while most federal representatives abstained pending review. The committee page did not expose a final adopted plan by cutoff, and no appropriation or agency funding decision had occurred, so the item remains a completeness lead rather than an implemented spending action.

rejected_candidates.title: ATF standalone-system breach
rejected_candidates.reason: ATF confirmed unauthorized access and called the event a major incident, but it occurred and was reported before the exact checked boundary. Attribution to the Qilin group and claimed data theft remained unverified; the confirmed incident is retained for a later bounded completeness review with the agency statement and incident-response record.

rejected_candidates.title: Overseas online passport-renewal proposal
rejected_candidates.reason: The State Department formally proposed expanding online renewal abroad, but the proposal was not final or implemented and the procedural expansion did not clear this run's materiality threshold.

rejected_candidates.title: FMCS arbitration-panel correction and older arms-sale notices
rejected_candidates.reason: The mediation rule was republished to repair a technical display error, and the arms-sale notices reflected earlier notified actions rather than new decisions in the review window. Neither was counted again.

rejected_candidates.title: G20 meeting agenda and trilateral military exercise announcement
rejected_candidates.reason: The items described an upcoming finance-ministers meeting and a recurring planned exercise, not a completed agreement, new expenditure, force decision, or measured result by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Routine and state-specific Federal Register notices
rejected_candidates.reason: Arkansas air-plan action, grant-administration notices, information collections, personnel matters, and narrow adjudications did not materially change nationwide policy or risk.

rejected_candidates.title: Duplicate Lake America, mail-ballot, ICE, Anthropic, and vehicle-rollback coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: Previously published events were not recounted. The new Science economic analysis was retained only as an explicit, separately adjudicated effectiveness lifecycle stage linked against the legacy rollback announcement.

rejected_candidates.title: Unresolved refinery-waiver, visitor-visa, CIA, Watson, Mar-a-Lago, and Pentagon posture reports
rejected_candidates.reason: No final EPA action, published visitor-visa directive, disclosed Moscow agreement, public military charge sheet, independently confirmed Mar-a-Lago filing, troop decision, or primary missile-inventory record appeared by cutoff.
